semanticAssessment: jest ran the file (7 tests, 7 failed, no suite or compile error). The target failed on its first planned assertion: the banner heading "Deliveries to this endpoint are paused" is absent (findByText timed out with the page rendered, the old banner present). The 1-held, 0-held and resume-button arms failed the same way, on the missing banner copy (their deliveries contain no HELD row, so they are judged on the banner alone). The three badge/filter arms failed differently, and that is a finding in its own right: the shipped page throws TypeError reading deliveryStatusConfig[HELD].icon (status-badge.tsx:109), so ANY delivery log containing a HELD row (which the Task 2 backend now returns) crashes the whole detail page. Those three are render crashes, not assertion failures, and are not offered as the RED evidence; the GREEN commit fixes both.
